case: First LoRA chapter: source review, verified audio and practice integration
scope: Source-based production observations; not a blinded human study or a controlled head-to-head score
rubric: Full fine-tuning updates model parameters; copying a model is not the learning mechanism.
Distinguish per-task weight storage from training memory for gradients and optimizer state.
The up-to-threefold hardware claim requires adaptive optimizers and its stated reason.
Rank is not matrix size or numerical update magnitude; omit unnecessary rank details in this opening if not required.
Define weights/parameters, frozen, matrices and any optimizer terms plainly before relying on them.
Explain conditional generation and input/target sequences in words; literal set notation is not required for semantic coverage.
Keep the roughly 175-billion-parameter GPT-3 example and its deployment context.
Use short spoken sentences and keep claims tied to appropriate evidence.

observations.notes: Repeated corrections retained dense notation and inadequate beginner definitions. One reviewer suggestion incorrectly treated rank as matrix size; a later review caught it. Generic examples and accurate paraphrases were sometimes over-rejected.

observations.status: First chapter published after source review; 63 of 63 utterances passed audio checks; HTTPS read/answer integration and real browser playback passed
observations.limitations: Sequential revision with inherited work, not a controlled model comparison. Two final prerequisite definitions were supplied by Codex and rechecked before audio generation.

acceptance.remaining: Other chapters and the automatic candidate batch are still being generated; physical second-PC microphone and 72-hour observation are not complete.

followup.initial_result: Stopped before publication after repeated source review failures.
issues_observed: Unsupported judgments about prompt fragility and scaling were introduced during whole-chapter rewrites.
Several background explanations blurred factorized representation, full update shape, and relationships to frozen weights.
The final spoken text included wording about source fragments.
followup.response: Preserve the failed draft, record independent source-based findings, repair only indicated sentences and their immediate context, then repeat full evidence review.
followup.limits: This follow-up also uses independent Codex findings; it does not establish fully autonomous scientific teaching quality.
followup.current_result: The second chapter passed source review and all 49 speech checks; it is now available. The third chapter is being generated.
followup.remaining: This does not establish fully autonomous long-form teaching quality; the second chapter also received independent Codex findings.
